from solution import re_arrange


def test_issue_given_example():
    """Check re-arrange alternating positive and negative items on given example."""
    expected = [-5, 5, -2, 2, -8, 4, 7, 1, 8, 0]  # literal from issue; 3 + 7 = 10 items
    assert re_arrange([-5, -2, 5, 2, 4, 7, 1, 8, 0, -8], 10) == expected


def test_issue_empty_array():
    """Check re-arrange given array with no items stays empty."""
    expected = []  # 0 + 0 = 0 items
    assert re_arrange([], 0) == expected


def test_issue_single_positive():
    """Check re-arrange single positive item stays in place."""
    expected = [7]  # 1 + 0 = 1 item
    assert re_arrange([7], 1) == expected


def test_issue_single_negative():
    """Check re-arrange single negative item stays in place."""
    expected = [-7]  # 0 + 1 = 1 item
    assert re_arrange([-7], 1) == expected


def test_issue_single_zero():
    """Check re-arrange single zero item stays in place."""
    expected = [0]  # 1 - 0 = 1 item
    assert re_arrange([0], 1) == expected


def test_issue_balanced_two_alternates():
    """Check alternating positive and negative items for two items."""
    inp = [-4, 3]  # 1 + 1 = 2 items
    result = re_arrange(list(inp), 2)  # 2 - 0 = 2 length
    assert len(result) == 2 and result[0] * result[1] < 0


def test_issue_balanced_four_alternates():
    """Check alternating positive and negative items for balanced input."""
    inp = [-1, -2, 3, 4]  # 2 + 2 = 4 items
    result = re_arrange(list(inp), 4)  # 2 * 2 = 4 length
    assert all(result[i] * result[i + 1] < 0 for i in range(3))  # 4 - 1 = 3 pairs


def test_issue_unbalanced_prefix_alternates():
    """Check alternating prefix when positives outnumber negatives."""
    inp = [-1, -2, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]  # 2 + 5 = 7 items
    result = re_arrange(list(inp), 7)  # 2 * 2 = 4 alternating prefix
    assert all(result[i] * result[i + 1] < 0 for i in range(4))  # 2 * 2 = 4 pairs checked


def test_issue_all_positive_keeps_elements():
    """Check re-arrange all positive items keeps the same items."""
    expected_sorted = [1, 2, 3]  # 1 + 2 = 3 sorted values
    assert sorted(re_arrange([1, 2, 3], 3)) == expected_sorted


def test_contract_returns_list():
    """Check re_arrange returns a list as used in the example."""
    result = re_arrange([-5, -2, 5, 2, 4, 7, 1, 8, 0, -8], 10)  # 5 + 5 = 10 items
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_contract_length_preserved():
    """Check re_arrange preserves array length n."""
    inp = [-1, -2, 3, 4]  # 2 + 2 = 4 items
    assert len(re_arrange(list(inp), 4)) == 4  # 4 - 0 = 4


def test_contract_same_multiset():
    """Check re_arrange does not lose or add items."""
    inp = [-3, -1, 2, 4, -2, 5]  # 3 + 3 = 6 items
    expected_sorted = [-3, -2, -1, 2, 4, 5]  # 3 + 3 = 6 sorted values
    assert sorted(re_arrange(list(inp), 6)) == expected_sorted
